_about: A class's passive features as documents (rules/classfeatures.py), keyed by the slug of
the grant on the class table. Read live; nothing is stored on a sheet. Blood Bending is
the owner's homebrew (content/classes/blood-bending.json, imported from the author's
PDF). Its table prints a `fist` die and "fast movement 10ft / 20ft" and says nothing
more about either; both are written here the monk's way because the class's fist ladder
is the monk's to the die (1d6 ... 2d10). The PDF was not re-read for this, so the armour
clause is an inference from that likeness, and the owner may overrule it.

unarmed-strike.name: Unarmed strike
unarmed-strike.source: content/classes/blood-bending.json, the level table's `fist` column (1d6 at 1st ... 2d10 at 20th). Measured 2026-10-05: nothing read that column, so a Blood Bender's bare fist was the table's 1d3 at every level.

fast-movement.name: Fast movement
fast-movement.source: content/classes/blood-bending.json: "fast movement 10ft" at 3rd and "fast movement 20ft" at 13th. The monk's reading (an enhancement bonus, lost in armour or under a medium or heavy load) is assumed — see `_about`.
